key_insight: A deterministic multi-agent workflow can reduce two major LLM safety failures in healthcare: handing off too early and giving unflagged hallucinated diagnoses.
clinical_relevance: By enforcing complete symptom collection and checking output uncertainty before release, the framework aims to make AI-assisted diagnostic support more structured and safer for clinical use.
method: Blocks diagnostic handoff until all OLDCARTS fields are collected.
Uses semantic entropy across 5 independent diagnostic samples to flag divergent outputs.
Replaces LLM-based routing with deterministic orchestration constraints.
evidence_signal: In 150 simulated test cases using llama-3.1-70b-instruct patient agents, the full system reached 49.3% diagnostic precision, an 11.3-point absolute gain over baseline, with a significant negative correlation between OLDCARTS completeness and semantic entropy (r = -0.181, p < 0.05).
watch_item: Results were obtained in simulation with a specific model setup, so real-world performance, workflow fit, and false-blocking of useful diagnostic progress still need validation.
paper_title: Agentic AI-based Framework for Mitigating Premature Diagnostic Handoff and Silent Hallucination in Healthcare Applications
